    Repeated questions
    Six predefined questions were asked once more of each version. These are unjudged diagnostics, excluded from quality averages. Two samples do not establish reliability.
    f01_bookshop_connection
    Before
    First response
    It sounds like the pleasure may have come from more than the novel itself: you got to linger in a small bookshop after work and share your interest with someone who knew the book. What felt best—the conversation, discovering something about the novel, or having an unhurried moment?
    Repeated response
    Maybe it was the mix of discovering a novel and having an easy, personal conversation with the owner after work. The small bookshop may have made the moment feel different from the rest of your day, too. What part do you find yourself enjoying most when you think back on it?
    After
    First response
    Maybe it was the mix of discovering a novel and sharing your interest with someone who knew the shop well. The conversation may have felt especially good because it was unhurried and happened naturally after work. What part of talking with the owner stayed with you most?
    Repeated response
    Maybe it was the combination of finding a novel that caught your interest and sharing an easy conversation with someone who knew it well. Which part felt most satisfying—the book itself, the connection, or the chance to linger after work?
